business_problem: IBM’s marketing teams needed a faster, more standardized way to create brand-compliant assets at scale because content drafting, research, editing, and template preparation were consuming too much of marketers’ time and reducing capacity for strategy and major market moments.
solution_summary: IBM built Creative Assistant as a purpose-built generative AI platform for marketing content production rather than a generic chat tool. A user prompt triggers microservices, APIs, and task-oriented agents that use retrieval-augmented generation with Elasticsearch to combine user-supplied context with trusted IBM sources such as IBM.com, product documentation, brand guidelines, RedBooks, Seismic, and competitive research. After reranking selects the most relevant evidence, an LLM hosted on IBM watsonx.ai—often Granite, but not always—generates content in prebuilt templates for emails, blog posts, client stories, presentations, and product pages. Indexed data is refreshed through automated storage and retrieval workflows using IBM Cloud Object Storage, Elasticsearch, Milvus, and watsonx.data, while Instana observes the next-generation chat experience. This gives marketers a governed content-production stack that accelerates drafting, standardizes brand voice, and democratizes access to product knowledge without removing writers and editors from review and refinement.

solution_components.name: Creative Assistant
solution_components.role: Serves as the marketer-facing interface for generating brand-aligned draft content across many asset formats.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Hosts the large language models and generation logic used to produce tailored marketing content.

solution_components.name: IBM Granite
solution_components.role: Provides one of the enterprise-grade foundation model options used for creative generation tasks.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Object Storage
solution_components.role: Stores and helps refresh the trusted data sources that feed the retrieval layer.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Databases for Elasticsearch
solution_components.role: Supports vector-based retrieval and search across public and private marketing knowledge sources.

solution_components.name: Milvus
solution_components.role: Acts as part of the vector search layer used to ground generation in relevant content.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.data
solution_components.role: Hosts vector-store components that help the assistant query trusted content efficiently.

solution_components.name: IBM Instana Observability
solution_components.role: Monitors the newer agent-driven chat experience in production.

data_flow: A marketer submits a prompt, Creative Assistant enriches it with trusted IBM content retrieved from Elasticsearch, Milvus, and watsonx.data-backed stores, watsonx.ai and Granite generate a templated draft, and the resulting asset moves to writers and editors for brand-compliant review and refinement.
business_outcome: Creative Assistant accelerated content production, improved consistency, reduced drafting time for high-volume programs like client stories, and freed marketing teams to focus more on strategy and higher-impact creative work.
metrics: 2400+ client story drafts and versions generated
client story one-pagers reduced from roughly an hour to about 12 minutes
architecture_clues: The system uses RAG with Elasticsearch plus a reranking service before generation.
Trusted data sources are periodically indexed into Elasticsearch and Milvus via Cloud Object Storage and watsonx.data.
The next-generation version adds agent-driven chat, Instana monitoring, and style-guide review capabilities.
